release_notes: Updates the existing Mystic Run game using its original application ID and signing key. Install the APK over the existing game. Includes the refined Knight, Gargoyle, Witch, material finish and free scenery. The same-package, same-certificate and higher-version checks passed; save/load functions, profile defaults and progression format are unchanged from build 1016. Physical-phone testing remains open.
